note: Dimensions in feet. height_ft = post height (wall bracket: mounting height). light.dz_ft is the flame height above the post base, light.dx_ft how far the flame sits toward the road. dim/bright are Foundry light radii in ft.

wrought_iron.name: Wrought-iron post and lantern
wrought_iron.description: Slender black iron post on a stone footing with a glazed four-sided lantern on top. Town streets.

wooden_oil.name: Wooden post, hanging oil lantern
wooden_oil.description: Rough timber post with a braced arm and a small oil lantern on a chain. Village streets.

stone_pillar.name: Stone pillar lantern
stone_pillar.description: Squat stone pillar with a capstone and an iron-framed lantern box. Gates, plazas, main road.

bracket_wall.name: Wall bracket lamp
bracket_wall.description: Iron bracket with a hanging lantern fixed to the nearest building wall (skipped where no wall is within reach).

torch_post.name: Torch post
torch_post.description: Wooden post with an iron torch basket. Dirt roads, outskirts, gates. Strong flicker.

shepherd_crook.name: Shepherd's crook lamp
shepherd_crook.description: Thin iron post with a curved crook and a hanging lantern. Lanes and rustic paths.
